title: Open an existing lock file without O_CREAT
summary: Review of the launcher without the reservation guard found that both lock opens used O_CREAT. fs.protected_regular refuses an O_CREAT open of a file another account owns under sticky /tmp, so a launch by any account other than the lock owner failed before preflight. The launcher now opens an existing lock read-only and creates one with O_EXCL only when host cleanup removed it. A test simulates the refusal. AGENTS.md keeps the retained host reservation state until the program lead releases it.
next: Merge the launcher change and launch the Step 2 captures as james.
reason: The change alters how the launcher opens a lock file; no roadmap marker, recorded fact, gate or published result changes.
